meta.title: Simple Taxonomy Refreshed demo
meta.description: The released plugin from WordPress.org, with five custom taxonomies, extra functions on Tags, sample posts and a page of the plugin's blocks. Built from the playground folder by npm run assets-blueprint.
meta.author: NeilWJames
